How Meta built AR glasses that weigh less than a normal pair of sunglasses
caption:
Meta's new AR glasses weigh just 100 grams and deliver the full AR experience Apple charged $3,500 for, including micro-OLED displays, eye tracking, and hand tracking on a frame you can actually wear all day.

The Apple Vision Pro sits at around 600 grams and costs roughly three times as much. Meta shrank the same core technology to a sixth of the weight. That gap matters more than any spec sheet: the headset people actually put on every morning is the one that replaces the phone in your pocket.
